## Before opening

- [ ] I searched open and closed issues and existing pull requests for duplicates.
- [ ] I read the contributing guidelines and relevant documentation.

## Problem or proposal

Describe the problem, who it affects and the expected behavior.

## Reproduction and environment

For bugs: steps, actual result, plugin/SteamOS/Decky versions, and Steam or
Non-Steam game. Omit this section when it does not apply.

## Potential approach (optional)

Suggest a direction, alternatives and relevant files or tests if you know them.
Codebase familiarity is welcome; a complete solution is not required.

## Validation (optional)

How could we tell the change works? Distinguish observations from assumptions.

## Would you like to work on this?

Say whether you are proposing implementation or reporting the issue only.

<!-- Never attach credentials, cookies, account payloads or raw HTTP errors. -->
